MayKernel64 trust anchors are generated from the Mozilla CA Root Certificate
Store (snapshot dated November 5, 2026), extracted by the curl project.
The Mozilla certificate data is available under the Mozilla Public License,
version 2.0. See MPL-2.0.txt.

Bundle: https://curl.se/docs/caextract.html
Mozilla source: https://github.com/mozilla-firefox/firefox/blob/release/security/nss/lib/ckfw/builtins/certdata.txt
MayOS corresponding source: https://github.com/ZhongYeMay/MayOS/tree/v0.5.4-pre9/versions/0.5.4-pre9
The input PEM, its pinned SHA-256 and generator are included in that source.
